clue.text: A match for the devil

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned friction match was called a ...
Satan, the fallen angel, bears this name

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a nineteenth-century brand-name friction match, and the name of Satan before his fall.

clue.text: Departed, somewhat ill at ease

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone has left, feeling a little uncomfortable.
explanation.definitionFit: Late is a euphemism for dead, as in 'the late king', matching departed in the sense of deceased.

clue.text: Total triumph when, by arrangement, I met cop covertly

indicators.note: by arrangement says the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A secret rendezvous with a policeman was a great success.
explanation.definitionFit: A complete, outright win is a total triumph.

clue.text: Overcharge for a coat

definitions.meaning: a soft warm jacket, or a sheep's woolly coat

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to rip someone off by charging too much, and a sheep's coat of wool or a warm jacket.

clue.text: Knave getting man to join old army corps

parts.note: RASC was the Royal Army Service Corps, a former British Army corps
Al is a man's name

explanation.surface: A rogue enlists in a defunct army unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' and 'to join' are links; the corps comes first in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A knave is a dishonest rogue, a synonym of scoundrel.

clue.text: Ordered to put on clothes

definitions.meaning: soldiers ordered into line are said to be ..., as when a drill sergeant calls the ranks to align

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: military alignment of ranks, and having clothed oneself, both past-tense verbs.

clue.text: Expressing scornful opinion of French on horseback

parts.note: de is French for of
riding is being on horseback

explanation.surface: A Frenchman on a horse looks down his nose at people.
explanation.definitionFit: Deriding means mocking or ridiculing, expressing contempt.

clue.text: Prepared to fly with oriental politician to point inland

parts.note: E is east, the Orient
MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: in places the compass point inside the word land

parts.note: taken as written
E, east, is a compass point

explanation.surface: An Eastern politician got ready to fly to a destination in the interior.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inland' splits: 'in' puts E inside LAND to give LANED.
explanation.definitionFit: To emplane is to board an aircraft, so having emplaned is being ready to fly.

clue.text: Deaf aid used by harlot said to be taking a look inside

indicators.note: inside puts one piece within the other

parts.note: a strumpet is a harlot

indicators.note: said signals that a word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: peeking is taking a look

explanation.surface: A prostitute's hearing aid lets her peep in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said' makes the looking word sound like a mountain-top verb, and 'inside' puts that just after the harlot's first letter; a speaking trumpet was an ear trumpet.
explanation.definitionFit: A speaking trumpet was a horn-shaped device held to the ear to help the hard of hearing.

clue.text: Spending is, in a way, sharing

indicators.note: in a way here means in a different arrangement, signalling a rearrangement of letters

explanation.surface: Spending money is in some sense sharing it out.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispense is to distribute or hand out, so dispensing means sharing out.

clue.text: Riddle about writing a letter

indicators.note: about means going round, so the spelt-out letter wraps the other piece

parts.note: the letter T spelt out is tee
MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a piece of writing

explanation.surface: Someone sets a puzzle concerning how to write a letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Riddle' is not a puzzle here but a coarse sieve, the old verb and noun meaning to sift.
explanation.definitionFit: A temse is an old dialect word for a sieve, and a riddle is likewise a sieve for sifting.

clue.text: They tempt men to look for murderer in the streets

indicators.note: in places the killer inside the streets abbreviation

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, so STS for streets
Jack the Ripper, the Victorian London murderer

explanation.surface: Women who lure men are on the lookout for a killer on the streets.
explanation.definitionFit: Striptease performers entice male audiences, so they are people who tempt men.

clue.text: Lifting gear for American footballers?

definitions.meaning: a system of pulleys and rope for hoisting loads
blocking and tackling are what defensive players do in gridiron, so a whimsical name for them

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a pulley-and-rope hoist, and, whimsically, gridiron players who block and tackle.

clue.text: Reserves farm animals on lots

parts.note: livestock is called stock
piles means lots, a great many

explanation.surface: A farmer keeps livestock in plots of land as reserves.
explanation.definitionFit: Stockpiles are reserves built up for later use.

clue.text: Child gets point of the betting system

parts.note: a tot is a small child
E, east, is a compass point

explanation.surface: A youngster picks up the gist of how the bookies work.
explanation.walkthrough: The tote (totalisator) is the pool-betting system run at British racecourses.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for totalisator, the pool-betting machine and system used at racecourses.

clue.text: One book on birds for advanced students in America

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
NT, the New Testament, is a book of the Bible
ernes are sea eagles

explanation.surface: A single volume about birds is set for American graduate students.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link placing the birds after the book in this down-style charade.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US, interns (also spelt internes) are advanced medical students or recent graduates training in hospitals.

clue.text: A right to my bed in military headquarters

parts.note: taken as written
a bed is a base or foundation, as in a bed of concrete

explanation.surface: A soldier claims a right to their own bed at HQ.
explanation.definitionFit: An army base is a military installation serving as headquarters for troops.

clue.text: Numbers of sheep dipped in liquid rinse

indicators.note: dipped in puts the sheep inside the other letters, like a sheep plunged into a dip
liquid suggests flowing freely, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: a teg is a sheep in its second year

explanation.surface: Sheep are plunged into sheep-dip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'liquid' rearranges the rinse letters to INERS; 'dipped in' sinks the sheep into them, like a sheep dip. A teg is a farming word for a yearling sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: Integers are whole numbers.

clue.text: Putting something over skin, for example

definitions.meaning: laying a layer on top of something
skin is a protective outer layer, one instance of a coat

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the act of laying something on top, and a layer such as skin that wraps a body.

clue.text: Letter redirected to college

indicators.note: redirected suggests sending the letters a different way, rearranging them

parts.note: a note is a short letter

explanation.surface: A piece of mail is forwarded to a school.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton is the famous English public school whose full name is Eton College.

clue.text: Dirty mark on reverse, for example, of the French manuscript

indicators.note: on reverse says the whole string of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: eg, exempli gratia, means for example
du is French for of the

explanation.surface: A smear on the back of a French document.
explanation.definitionFit: A smudge is a smear or blur of dirt.

clue.text: Means of securing textile fibre

definitions.meaning: a bent metal fastener for holding papers together
the ... of wool or cotton is its fibre, judged by length and quality

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a wire fastener, and the fibre of cotton or wool graded by length.

clue.text: It is due to army chaps becoming thick-skinned

indicators.note: becoming means turning into something else, so these letters change into a new word

explanation.surface: Being insensitive comes from soldiers' rough life.
explanation.definitionFit: The word comes from the Greek for thick skin, describing elephants and, figuratively, insensitive people.

clue.text: Animals raised by celebrity

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: rats are animals

explanation.surface: Animals are reared by a famous person.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is a famous performer, a celebrity.

clue.text: View a leader takes in plan for the future

parts.note: to look is to view
a head is a leader or chief

explanation.surface: A chief executive's outlook is taken into the forward strategy.
explanation.definitionFit: To look ahead is to anticipate and prepare for what is coming, to plan for the future.

clue.text: Birdseed with sex appeal?

parts.note: a pip is a fruit seed
'it' is an old term for sex appeal, as in the 1920s It girl

explanation.surface: Is there something alluring about bird food?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Birdseed' looks like one item but splits into the definition and a piece of wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipit is a small brown songbird, so the answer is a kind of bird.

clue.text: Cast head as reserve

parts.note: to shy is to throw or cast, as at a coconut shy
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness's neighbour Dungeness

explanation.surface: Someone throws a ball at the head held back for later.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserve as a noun means reticence or diffidence, a synonym of bashfulness.

clue.text: Builder employed by English clergyman

parts.note: a rector is a parish priest

explanation.surface: A builder is hired by a parish priest from England.
explanation.definitionFit: One who erects or puts up structures is a builder.
